33.steps:
1. Put SonicWALL1 behind a NAT device.
  2. Configure a secondary WAN interface on X2 port of SonicWALL2. Enable WLB.
  3. Configure matching IKEv2 VPN policies on SonicWALL1 and SonicWALL2. 
  4. In a VPN policy on SonicWALL1, enter X1 IP address of a peer in the Primary IPSec Gateway field and X2 IP address of the peer in the Secondary IPSec Gateway address field. Phase1 SA life time=600 sec, Phase2 SA life time=600 sec. Enable DPD on SonicWALL1.
  5. In a VPN policy on SonicWALL2, enter 0.0.0.0 in the Primary IPSec Gateway field. Phase1 SA life time=1800 sec, Phase2 SA life time=1800 sec.
  6. Disconnect the cable on the primary WAN of SonicWALL2.
  7. Start a continuous ping from PC1 to PC2.
33.initial: PC1--X0 SonicWALL1 X1--NAT device-- X1,X2 SonicWALL2 X0-- PC2
33.title: Remote site is behind a NAT device. Primary gateway is not available.
33.result:
SonicWALL1 starts IKE_SA_INIT negotiation with primary gateway and fails after five retries.
  SonicWALL1 starts a new negotiation using the secondary IPSec gateway and creates IKE SA and IPsec SA with the secondary gateway.

7.steps:
